english.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for something that is not ordinary.
Use this as the all-purpose everyday equivalent when something is not typical or usual.
This is the all-purpose choice when something is out of the ordinary.
Use this for something noticeably unusual or out of the ordinary without necessarily suggesting a defect.
